column1: void TransferToPopoutWindow(const FName& name, UKDebugWidget* windowWidget)
column2:
BlueprintCallable
Call this function to transfer an existing widget to a popout window. The 'name' is the identifier used to destroy the window.

column1: UKDebugWidget* CreatePopoutWindow(const FName& name, TSubclassOf<UKDebugWidget> windowWidget)
column2:
BlueprintCallable
Call this function to create a new widget instance as a popout window. The 'name' is the identifier used to destroy the window.

BlueprintCallable
Call this function to destroy a popout window. The 'name' needs to match the 'name' set in TransferToPopoutWindow()/CreatePopoutWindow().

BlueprintCallable
Call this function to destroy all popout windows.

Overrideable
Override this function to update UI when a window is closed. The 'name' passed to this function will match a 'name' set in TransferToPopoutWindow()/CreatePopoutWindow().
